name: Elysium Heights
source:
Catherine is a small-town girl that was dealing with an abusive ex-boyfriend and was also stuck in a dead-end job, so she decided to move to the big city and share an apartment with her best friend Lisa.

Few months later, now working at a catering company, Catherine’s stuck again, still struggling to pay rent and with no perspectives in improving her life.

One morning on her day off, she receives a call from her boss with an unexpected offer to work that night at a fancy event in one of the most luxurious buildings in the city: Elysium Heights. 

The outcome of that night will change Catherine’s life forever...

[From [url=https://cesar-games.itch.io/elysium-heights]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
凯瑟琳是一个小镇女孩，她正在与一个虐待她的前男友打交道，而且还陷入了一份没有出路的工作，所以她决定搬到大城市，与她最好的朋友丽莎合租一套公寓。

几个月后，凯瑟琳在一家餐饮公司工作，她再次陷入困境，仍然难以支付房租，也没有改善生活的前景。

休息日的一天早上，她接到老板的电话，意外地收到了一份邀请，邀请她当晚在这座城市最豪华的建筑之一：极乐世界高地举办的一场盛大活动中工作。

那天晚上的结果将永远改变凯瑟琳的生活……

[来自[url=https://cesar-games.itch.io/elysium-heights]Itch.io[/url]]
